mcqs.question: Teejan Bai, who died in July 2026, was renowned for which of the following?
options: Pandavani singing of Mahabharata ballads in Chhattisgarh
Low-cost suspension bridge construction in Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana and Odisha
Singing more than 48,000 songs in 20 languages
Playing as a West Indies all-rounder
mcqs.explanation: Teejan Bai was renowned as a Pandavani singer known for performing Mahabharata ballads in Chhattisgarh. Low-cost suspension bridges were associated with Girish Bhardwaj, while the other options refer to S. Janaki and Sir Garfield Sobers.

mcqs.question: Teejan Bai, the noted Pandavani singer, was born in which place and received which honours?
options: Durg; Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan
Raipur; Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan
Kanker; four National Film Awards and 33 State awards
Nagpur; Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan
mcqs.explanation: Teejan Bai was born in Durg and was honoured with the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan. Raipur was the place of her death, while Kanker and Nagpur are associated with other entries in the July 2026 current-affairs coverage.
